title: Pothos - Golden Devils Ivy - Mini Plug Plants - 2x - Perfect For Terrariums
description: The product is a set of two mini plug plants of Golden Devil's Ivy (Pothos), perfect for terrariums. This indoor plant thrives in sub-tropical climates and prefers a loam soil type. Its climbing growth habit and green colour make it a striking addition to any room. Easy to care for with medium watering needs, this plant from the Epipremnum genus is ideal for beginners and experienced plant enthusiasts alike. Made in the United Kingdom, these plant plugs are a great choice for those who love houseplants and want to bring a touch of nature into their home.
